categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Fuzzing' and modifies the `FuzzedSock` mock utility and connman fuzzing harness.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading mock behavior in `FuzzedSock` that caused cross-peer event collisions in `CConnman::SocketHandler()` and missed OS error paths. As the description notes, previously 'every FuzzedSock had one of two socket values... which led the connman fuzz target to act on one peer with the events of another,' while error conditions and partial socket events went unexercised on critical P2P networking code.
